inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Concrete swallows the river’s tongue
We built a wall where the ancestors sung
The water rises, cold and thick
Burying the map, burying the ditch
They say the flood is clean, they say it’s new
But the mud knows the faces we knew

[Chorus]
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Feet in the clay, the valley trembles
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Blood in the bedrock, the silence tembles

[Verse]
Valve turns slow, the pressure climbs
Drowning the names, drowning the times
The old men walk on the submerged floor
With roots for legs and stone for core
They don’t scream, they just stand in the deep
Waking the giants from their sleep

[Chorus]
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Feet in the clay, the valley trembles
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Blood in the bedrock, the silence tembles

[Bridge]
(Percussion only)
Tom-tom... Tom-tom... Tom-tom... Tom-tom...
Silence...
(Explosion of riffs)
CRUSH!

[Solo]
(Distorted guitar solo)

[Chorus]
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Feet in the clay, the valley trembles
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Blood in the bedrock, the silence tembles

[Outro]
The dam breaks... The dam breaks...
Stone remembers... The dam breaks...
